text.price: $1,941 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 13.
text.record: Prices rose 22% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 20% for developments with similar features in District 13 — about the same as similar developments.
infrastructure: Bartley MRT, about 190 m (straight line to the nearest exit).
Maris Stella High School, about 400 m: 2 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.

text.answer: Right by an MRT station, a popular primary school within 1 km and a large development. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 13.
